notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. No text is stated. Opening words: “Think of that poor widow at Nain. She is an old woman now; and her only son, who is the staff of her life, is sick. How she watches him; …”
